title: Dataset Audit input CPPT RPA RPB
sql_query:
WITH laporan_akhir AS (  
    SELECT  
        id_kunjungan,  
        MAX(inserted_date::TIMESTAMP) FILTER (  
            WHERE role = 'Dokter'  
              AND asesmen_detail -> 'tindak_lanjut' ->> 'tindak_lanjut'::text = 'Diperbolehkan Pulang'  
        ) AS waktu_akhir_dokter,  
        MAX(inserted_date::TIMESTAMP) FILTER (  
            WHERE role = 'Apoteker'  
        ) AS waktu_akhir_apoteker  
    FROM emr_rawat_inap.cppt   
    GROUP BY id_kunjungan  
)  
SELECT  
    DISTINCT ri."ID REGISTRASI RANAP",  
    ri."NAMA PASIEN",  
    ri."NAMA RUANG",  
    ri."NO RM",  
    ri."TGL LAHIR",  
    ri."JENIS KELAMIN",  
    ri."SPESIALIS RAWAT INAP",  
    ri."DIAGNOSA UTAMA",  
    ri."PROSEDUR UTAMA",  
-- (ri."WAKTU IRNA AKHIR"::date - ri."WAKTU IRNA AWAL"::date) AS los_hari  
CASE   
        WHEN to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  IS NULL   
        OR to_timestamp("WAKTU IRNA AKHIR", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  IS NULL THEN NULL   
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) = DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) THEN '1'::NUMERIC  
        WHEN FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , now()) - to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )/86400) = 0 THEN '1'::NUMERIC  
        ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  + INTERVAL '1 DAY') - to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )::NUMERIC  
    END AS "LOS",  
    ri."Cara keluar",  
    TO_CHAR(la.waktu_akhir_dokter, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')   AS "WAKTU CPPT DOKTER TERAKHIR",  
    TO_CHAR(la.waktu_akhir_apoteker, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "WAKTU CPPT APOTEKER TERAKHIR",  
    ri."WAKTU PULANG"  
FROM emr_view.mv_rawat_inap ri  
JOIN  laporan_akhir la ON la.id_kunjungan =  ri."ID REGISTRASI RANAP"  
WHERE "NAMA RUANG" in (  
    '(RPA) PERAWATAN ANAK',  
    '(RPB) PERAWATAN BEDAH'  
    ) AND   
    "TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::TIMESTAMP BETWEEN '2026-09-13' AND '2026-10-07'   
      AND la.waktu_akhir_dokter IS NOT NULL  
      AND (  
            la.waktu_akhir_apoteker IS NULL                      -- apoteker tidak pernah input  
            OR la.waktu_akhir_apoteker < la.waktu_akhir_dokter  -- apoteker input hanya sebelum dokter  
      );

title: Jumlah Kunjungan Rawat Inap 2025 dan 2026
sql_query:
SELECT  
    DISTINCT ri."ID REGISTRASI RANAP",  
    ri."NAMA PASIEN",  
    ri."NO RM",  
    ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP" AS "TANGGAL MASUK",

CASE   
        WHEN to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  IS NULL   
        OR to_timestamp("WAKTU IRNA AKHIR", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  IS NULL THEN NULL   
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) = DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) THEN '1'::NUMERIC  
        WHEN FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , now()) - to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )/86400) = 0 THEN '1'::NUMERIC  
        ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  + INTERVAL '1 DAY') - to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )::NUMERIC  
    END AS "LOS",  
    ri."DIAGNOSA UTAMA",  
    ri."DPJP RAWAT INAP",  
    ri."Cara keluar" AS "STATUS PULANG",

    ri."WAKTU PULANG"  
FROM emr_view.mv_rawat_inap ri

WHERE  
    ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::TIMESTAMP >= '2025-01-01'::TIMESTAMP   
    AND ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::TIMESTAMP < '2026-10-01'::TIMESTAMP   
ORDER BY  
    ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP";

title: Riset 126
sql_query: WITH lab_pertama AS (     -- Mengambil waktu request Lab paling pertama per Id Registrasi     SELECT          mdl."Id Registrasi"::TEXT AS id_reg,         MIN(mdl.tanggal_request::TIMESTAMP) AS waktu_lab_awal     FROM emr_view.mv_dashboard_lab mdl     WHERE mdl.tanggal_request IS NOT NULL     GROUP BY mdl."Id Registrasi"::TEXT ), rad_pertama AS (     -- Mengambil waktu request Radiologi paling pertama per ID Kun     SELECT          mddr."ID Kun"::TEXT AS id_reg,         MIN(mddr.tanggal_request::TIMESTAMP) AS waktu_rad_awal     FROM emr_view.mv_dashboard_daftar_radiologi mddr     WHERE mddr.tanggal_request IS NOT NULL     GROUP BY mddr."ID Kun"::TEXT ) SELECT     mdi."No RM",     mdi."Id Registrasi",     mdi."Nama Pasien",     mdi."Tanggal Lahir",     -- 2. Kategori Umur (< 18 Anak, >= 18 Dewasa)     mdi."Umur",     CASE          WHEN NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(mdi."Umur"::TEXT, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::INT < 18 THEN 'Anak'         WHEN NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(mdi."Umur"::TEXT, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::INT >= 18 THEN 'Dewasa'         ELSE NULL     END AS "Kategori Umur",     -- 3. Kesimpulan Emergensi      mdi."Kesimpulan Emergensi" AS "Kategori Triage",     -- 4. Kategori SHIFT dari Waktu Triage     -- mdi."Waktu Triage",     (t.inserted_date + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIMESTAMP AS "Waktu Triage",     CASE         WHEN (t.inserted_date + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIME >= TIME '07:00:00'          AND (t.inserted_date + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIME <  TIME '14:00:00'             THEN 'Pagi'         WHEN (t.inserted_date + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIME >= TIME '14:00:00'          AND (t.inserted_date + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIME <  TIME '21:00:00'             THEN 'Siang'         WHEN (t.inserted_date + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIME >= TIME '21:00:00'           OR (t.inserted_date + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIME <  TIME '07:00:00'             THEN 'Malam'         ELSE NULL     END AS "SHIFT (Waktu Triage)",     -- 5. Kolom-kolom Timestamp & Status Outcome     mdi."Waktu Registrasi Awal",     mdi."Waktu Igd Medis Awal" AS "Waktu Pemeriksaan Dokter Pertama",           -- Mengambil waktu paling awal antara Lab dan Radiologi (otomatis mengabaikan jika salah satu NULL)     LEAST(lp.waktu_lab_awal, rp.waktu_rad_awal) AS "Waktu Instruksi Penunjang Pertama",          -- Menampilkan waktu masing-masing jika peneliti ingin mengecek sumbernya (bisa dihapus jika tidak perlu)     lp.waktu_lab_awal AS "Waktu Lab Pertama",     rp.waktu_rad_awal AS "Waktu Radiologi Pertama",          mdi."Waktu Igd Medis Akhir" AS "Waktu Keputusan Akhir",     mdi."Tindak Lanjut Akhir Igd" AS "Status Outcome",     mdi."Tanggal Pulang" AS "Timestamp Keluar Igd",     -- 6. Perhitungan LOS (Length of Stay)     ROUND(     (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (mdi."Tanggal Pulang"::TIMESTAMP - (t.inserted_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '7 hours'))) / 86400.0)::NUMERIC,      2     ) AS "LOS (Satuan Hari)"      FROM emr_view.mv_dashboard_igd mdi LEFT JOIN  emr_igd.asesmen_triage t on mdi."Id Triage" = t.id_triage LEFT JOIN lab_pertama lp ON mdi."Id Registrasi"::TEXT = lp.id_reg LEFT JOIN rad_pertama rp ON mdi."Id Registrasi"::TEXT = rp.id_reg WHERE (t.inserted_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIMESTAMP >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'   AND (t.inserted_date::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '7 hours')::TIMESTAMP <  TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY  mdi."Waktu Registrasi Awal" ASC ;

title: Kepatuhan RJ
sql_query:
SELECT   
    rj.*,  
    rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP AS "TGL REGIS",  
    ((rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP)::DATE)::TEXT || sd.schedule_doctor_id AS "ID PRAKTEK",  
    sd."WAKTU ASLI",  
    sd."WAKTU REVISI",  
    sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI",  
    sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI",  
    CASE  
        -- Datang lebih awal > 60 menit sebelum jadwal asli dokter  
        WHEN (DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU ASLI" - rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP) / 60) > 60   
            THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        -- Datang <= 60 menit sebelum jadwal asli ATAU sesudah jadwal asli  
        ELSE 'Sesuai'  
    END AS "KATEGORI"  
FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan rj   
LEFT JOIN (  
    SELECT  
        a.schedule_doctor_id,  
        a.registration_id,  
        (jda.tanggal_asli::TEXT || ' ' || sda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP   AS "WAKTU ASLI",  
        (jda.tanggal::TEXT || ' ' || jda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP        AS "WAKTU REVISI",  
        (jda.tanggal_asli::TEXT || ' ' || sda.time_finish)::TIMESTAMP  AS "WAKTU SELESAI ASLI",  
        (jda.tanggal::TEXT || ' ' || jda.time_finish)::TIMESTAMP       AS "WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"  
    FROM public.antrianlists a  
    LEFT JOIN public.jadwal_dokter_aktif jda ON jda.id_jadwal_dokter_aktif = a.id_jadwal_dokter_aktif  
    LEFT JOIN public.schedule_doctors sda ON sda.id = a.schedule_doctor_id  
) sd ON sd.registration_id = rj."ID REGISTRASI"  
WHERE sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL   
  AND sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL  
  AND rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP >= '2026-01-01';

p.date::timestamp as "TANGGAL PENERIMAAN",  
(p.kedatangan_tgl::date - po."TGL PO"::date) AS "SELISIH HARI",

        -- belom diterima

        -- sudah diterima , < 2minggu > 2 minggu ( penerimaan),   
        ELSE 'DITERIMA > 2 MINGGU'

title: Kepatuhan Rj + Kat real
sql_query:
SELECT   
    sub.*,  
      
    -- KATEGORI 2: Level Sesi Praktik (ID PRAKTEK)  
    -- Jika ada >= 1 pasien tidak sesuai di sesi tersebut, seluruh sesi jadi 'Tidak Sesuai'  
    CASE   
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sub.kategori_pasien = 'Tidak Sesuai' THEN 1 END) OVER (  
            PARTITION BY sub."ID PRAKTEK"  
        ) > 0 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        ELSE 'Sesuai'  
    END AS "KATEGORI_SESI",

    -- KATEGORI 3: Level Bulanan Dokter  
    -- Jika ada >= 1 catatan tidak sesuai dalam 1 bulan, seluruh baris dokter di bulan itu jadi 'Tidak Sesuai'  
    CASE   
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sub."KATEGORI" = 'Tidak Sesuai' THEN 1 END) OVER (  
            PARTITION BY sub."DOKTER", DATE_TRUNC('month', sub."TGL REGIS")  
        ) > 0 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        ELSE 'Sesuai'  
    END AS "KATEGORI_BULANAN",  
      
    -- KATEGORI 4 = Tidak ada Toleransi Beda Jadwal  
    CASE   
        WHEN sub."WAKTU ASLI" = sub."WAKTU REVISI"  
             AND sub."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI" = sub."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"  
        THEN 'Sesuai'  
        ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'  
    END AS "KATEGORI_4",  
      
      -- KATEGORI 5: Level Sesi Praktik (ID PRAKTEK)  
    -- Jika ada >= 1 pasien tidak sesuai di sesi tersebut, seluruh sesi jadi 'Tidak Sesuai'  
    CASE   
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sub.kategori_pasien5 = 'Tidak Sesuai' THEN 1 END) OVER (  
            PARTITION BY sub."ID PRAKTEK"  
        ) > 0 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        ELSE 'Sesuai'  
    END AS "KATEGORI_5",  
      
    -- KATEGORI 6: Level Bulanan Dokter2  
    -- Jika ada >= 1 catatan tidak sesuai dalam 1 bulan (Kategori 4), seluruh baris dokter di bulan itu jadi 'Tidak Sesuai'  
-- KATEGORI 6: Level Bulanan Dokter berdasarkan KATEGORI 4  
    CASE   
        WHEN COUNT(  
            CASE   
                WHEN sub."WAKTU ASLI" <> sub."WAKTU REVISI"  
                  OR sub."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI" <> sub."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"  
                THEN 1  
            END  
        ) OVER (  
            PARTITION BY sub."DOKTER", DATE_TRUNC('month', sub."TGL REGIS")  
        ) > 0   
        THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        ELSE 'Sesuai'  
    END AS "KATEGORI_6",  
      
    -- KATEGORI 7 : toleransi 30 menit sebelum task id 4  
    sub.kategori_task4 AS "KATEGORI REAL"

FROM (  
    SELECT   
        rj.*,  
        rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP AS "TGL REGIS",  
        ((rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP)::DATE)::TEXT || sd.schedule_doctor_id AS "ID PRAKTEK",  
        sd.schedule_doctor_id,  
        sd."WAKTU ASLI",  
        sd."WAKTU REVISI",  
        sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI",  
        sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI",  
        -- Evaluasi internal pasien (hanya dipakai window function di atas)  
        CASE  
            WHEN rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP  
                 BETWEEN sd."WAKTU ASLI" - INTERVAL '1 hour'  
                     AND sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"  
            THEN 'Sesuai'  
            ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        END AS kategori_pasien,  
        CASE  
            WHEN ak."TANGGAL INPUT ASKEP"::TIMESTAMP  
                 BETWEEN sd."WAKTU ASLI" - INTERVAL '1 hour'  
                     AND sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"  
            THEN 'Sesuai'  
            ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        END AS kategori_pasien5,  
          
        -- t4."TASK 4",  
        t4."TASK 1",  
        t4."TASK 2",  
        t4."TASK 3",  
        t4."TASK 4",  
        MIN(t4."TASK 4") OVER (  
            PARTITION BY ((rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP)::DATE)::TEXT || sd.schedule_doctor_id  
        ) AS "TASK 4 PERTAMA",  
        -- Level sesi: pasien pertama task_id_4 maks 30 menit sebelum jadwal asli  
        CASE  
            WHEN MIN(t4."TASK 4") OVER (  
                    PARTITION BY ((rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP)::DATE)::TEXT || sd.schedule_doctor_id  
                 )  
                 BETWEEN sd."WAKTU ASLI" - INTERVAL '30 minutes'  
                     AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" + INTERVAL '30 minutes'  
            THEN 'Sesuai'  
            ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        END AS kategori_task4,

        CASE  
            WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 <= 60  
                 AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 <= 60 THEN 'Sesuai'  
            WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60  
                 AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
            WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 <= 60  
                 AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
            WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60  
                 AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 <= 60 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
            WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NULL THEN 'Sesuai'  
            WHEN sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NULL THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'  
        END AS "KATEGORI"

    FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan rj   
    LEFT JOIN (  
        SELECT  
            a.schedule_doctor_id,  
            a.registration_id,  
            (jda.tanggal_asli::TEXT || ' ' || sda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP   AS "WAKTU ASLI",  
            (jda.tanggal::TEXT || ' ' || jda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP        AS "WAKTU REVISI",  
            (jda.tanggal_asli::TEXT || ' ' || sda.time_finish)::TIMESTAMP  AS "WAKTU SELESAI ASLI",  
            (jda.tanggal::TEXT || ' ' || jda.time_finish)::TIMESTAMP       AS "WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"  
        FROM public.antrianlists a  
        LEFT JOIN public.jadwal_dokter_aktif jda ON jda.id_jadwal_dokter_aktif = a.id_jadwal_dokter_aktif  
        LEFT JOIN public.schedule_doctors sda ON sda.id = a.schedule_doctor_id  
    ) sd ON sd.registration_id = rj."ID REGISTRASI"  
    LEFT JOIN (  
        select   
            ak.id_kunjungan,  
            ak.inserted_date + interval '7 hours' as "TANGGAL INPUT ASKEP"  
        from emr_rawat_jalan.asesmen_keperawatan ak   
        where ak.deleted_date is null  
        ) ak on ak.id_kunjungan = rj."ID REGISTRASI"  
    LEFT JOIN (  
        SELECT  
            jkn.id_registrations,  
            MAX(CASE WHEN jkn.task_id = 1 THEN jkn.tanggal AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta' END) AS "TASK 1",  
            MAX(CASE WHEN jkn.task_id = 2 THEN jkn.tanggal AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta' END) AS "TASK 2",  
            MAX(CASE WHEN jkn.task_id = 3 THEN jkn.tanggal AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta' END) AS "TASK 3",  
            MAX(CASE WHEN jkn.task_id = 4 THEN jkn.tanggal AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta' END) AS "TASK 4"  
        FROM public.antrianjkn jkn  
        WHERE jkn.task_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4)  
          AND jkn.terkirim IS TRUE  
        GROUP BY jkn.id_registrations  
    ) t4 ON t4.id_registrations = rj."ID REGISTRASI"  
    WHERE sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL   
      AND sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL  
      AND rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP >= '2026-01-01'  
      AND rj."SPESIALIS" NOT IN (  
      'AKUPUNKTUR',  
      'ANESTESI',  
      'FISIOTERAPI',  
      'GIGI Umum',  
      'GIZI KLINIK',  
      'KEDOKTERAN OKUPASI',  
      'LAKTASI',  
      'MCU',  
      'MEMORI',  
      'OKUPASI TERAPIS',  
      'PSIKOLOGI KLINIS',  
      'RADIOLOGI',  
      'TERAPI NYERI',  
      'TERAPI PERILAKU',  
      'TERAPI WICARA'  
    )  
        
) sub

title: Monitoring Hak Kelas Bed BPJS RANAP
sql_query: WITH ri AS (     SELECT         ri.*,         b.nama_kelas AS "NAMA KELAS",         -- normalisasi: "KELAS I" / "KELAS 1" -> '1'         CASE upper(trim(regexp_replace(ri."HAK KELAS BPJS", '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))             WHEN 'I' THEN '1' WHEN 'II' THEN '2' WHEN 'III' THEN '3'             ELSE upper(trim(regexp_replace(ri."HAK KELAS BPJS", '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))         END AS hak_kelas_norm,         CASE upper(trim(regexp_replace(b.nama_kelas, '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))             WHEN 'I' THEN '1' WHEN 'II' THEN '2' WHEN 'III' THEN '3'             ELSE upper(trim(regexp_replace(b.nama_kelas, '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))         END AS kelas_bed_norm,         CASE             WHEN DATE_PART('day', ri."WAKTU PULANG"::timestamp - ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp) = 0 THEN 1             ELSE DATE_PART('day', ri."WAKTU PULANG"::timestamp - ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp) + 1         END AS "LOS"     FROM emr_view.mv_rawat_inap ri 	left join (SELECT mb_1.id, 	                    mb_1.name AS nama_bed, 	                    mb_1.kelas_id, 	                    mb_1.kamar_id, 	                    mkk.nama_kelas  	                   FROM ms_beds mb_1 	             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mk_1.id, 	                    mk_1.name AS nama_kelas, 	                    mk_1.remark 	                   FROM ms_kelaskamars mk_1 	                  WHERE mk_1."deletedAt" IS NULL) mkk ON mkk.id = mb_1.kelas_id) b on b.nama_bed = ri."NAMA BED"     WHERE ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp >= '2026-01-01'     and "NAMA ASURANSI" = 'BPJS'     --  AND ri.waktu_dihapus IS NULL ), sesuai AS (     SELECT         "ID REGISTRASI RANAP",         COALESCE(             bool_or(                 kelas_bed_norm = hak_kelas_norm                 AND date_start::timestamp <= "TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp + interval '72 hours'             ), false         ) AS pernah_sesuai,         string_agg(DISTINCT "NAMA KELAS", ', ') AS riwayat_kelas     FROM ri     GROUP BY "ID REGISTRASI RANAP" ), last_bed AS (     SELECT DISTINCT ON ("ID REGISTRASI RANAP") *     FROM ri     ORDER BY "ID REGISTRASI RANAP", date_start DESC NULLS LAST ) SELECT     lb."ID REGISTRASI RANAP",     lb."ID REGISTRASI ASAL",     lb."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp AS "TGL REGISTRASI RANAP",     lb."NO RM",     lb."NAMA PASIEN",     lb."TGL LAHIR",     lb."UMUR",     lb."JENIS KELAMIN",     lb."DPJP RAWAT INAP",     lb."SPESIALIS RAWAT INAP",     lb."NAMA ASURANSI",     lb."HAK KELAS BPJS",     lb."NAMA RUANG",     lb."NAMA KAMAR",     lb."NAMA BED"   AS "BED TERAKHIR",     lb."NAMA KELAS" AS "KELAS BED TERAKHIR",     s.riwayat_kelas AS "RIWAYAT KELAS BED",     CASE         WHEN lb."NAMA ASURANSI" <> 'BPJS' THEN 'Non BPJS'         WHEN s.pernah_sesuai THEN 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "STATUS BED SESUAI",     case  	    when "WAKTU PULANG" is null then 'Belum Pulang'     	when kelas_bed_norm = hak_kelas_norm then 'Sesuai'     	else 'Tidak Sesuai'     end as "STATUS BED SESUAI (PULANG)",     case 	    when "WAKTU PULANG" is null then 'Belum Pulang'         WHEN lb."NAMA ASURANSI" <> 'BPJS' THEN 'Non BPJS'         WHEN s.pernah_sesuai and kelas_bed_norm = hak_kelas_norm THEN 'Sesuai' --        and kelas_bed_norm = hak_kelas_norm then 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "STATUS BED SESUAI KESELURUHAN",     lb."DIAGNOSA UTAMA",     lb."DIAGNOSA SEKUNDER",     lb."PROSEDUR UTAMA",     lb."PROSEDUR SEKUNDER",     lb."WAKTU PULANG"::timestamp AS "WAKTU PULANG",     lb."Cara keluar",     lb."LOS" FROM last_bed lb JOIN sesuai s ON s."ID REGISTRASI RANAP" = lb."ID REGISTRASI RANAP"

title: Forecast Penjualan Obat Farmasi
sql_query: -- ============================================================ -- PARETO ABC (VARIAN SUPPLIER DIGABUNG) + DATA HARIAN UNTUK FORECASTING -- Periode: 1 Maret 2026 s/d 30 September 2026 -- ============================================================ with a as ( select distinct on (mvp."ID TRANSAKSI", mvp."QTY", mvp."HARGA POKOK")  *, trim(regexp_replace(upper(mvp."BARANG"), '\s*${[}^{(})]*$\s*$', '')) as "BARANG GABUNGAN" -- nama tanpa suffix supplier from emr_view.mv_validasi_penjualan mvp  LEFT JOIN public.transaksi_detail_barangs p ON p.id = mvp."ID TRANSAKSI" left join (     select id, is_active     from public.wf_ms_barangs wmb      where wmb."deletedAt" is null       and wmb.hargapokok is not null -- Abaikan jika harga pokok di master NULL ) b on b.id = mvp."ID BARANG" where mvp.tarif_cbg = 'obat' and mvp."TGL JUAL"::timestamp >= '2026-03-01' and mvp."TGL JUAL"::timestamp <  '2026-10-01' AND mvp."ID KUNJUNGAN" IS NOT NULL and p."deletedAt" IS null and is_active is true and mvp."HARGA POKOK" is not null -- Abaikan jika harga pokok di transaksi NULL ), gbb as (  select      count(distinct date_trunc('month', "TGL JUAL"::TIMESTAMP)) as "JUMLAH BULAN",     count(distinct date_trunc('day', "TGL JUAL"::TIMESTAMP)) as "JUMLAH HARI" from a ), gbo as (  select      "ID BARANG",     "BARANG",     "BARANG GABUNGAN",     SUM("QTY") as "JUMLAH PENJUALAN",     (select "JUMLAH BULAN" from gbb) as "JUMLAH BULAN",     round(SUM("QTY")::numeric/(select "JUMLAH BULAN" from gbb), 2) as "AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN PERBULAN",     (select "JUMLAH HARI" from gbb) as "JUMLAH HARI",     round(SUM("QTY")::numeric/(select "JUMLAH HARI" from gbb), 2) as "AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN hari"  from a  group by "ID BARANG", "BARANG", "BARANG GABUNGAN"  ), gba as (   select      gbo.*,     hargapokok as "HARGA POKOK",     stockmin as "STOK MIN",     stockmax as "STOK MAX",     "AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN PERBULAN" * hargapokok as "RP"  from gbo  inner join (     select id, hargapokok, stockmin, stockmax     from public.wf_ms_barangs     where "deletedAt" is null       and hargapokok is not null  ) h on h.id = gbo."ID BARANG" ), -- Gabungkan varian supplier (Rp dijumlah dari Rp per ID, harga pokok = rata-rata tertimbang) gbm as (  select     min("ID BARANG") as "ID BARANG",     "BARANG GABUNGAN" as "BARANG",     string_agg(distinct "ID BARANG"::text, ',') as "ID ASLI",     sum("JUMLAH PENJUALAN") as "JUMLAH PENJUALAN",     max("JUMLAH BULAN") as "JUMLAH BULAN",     sum("AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN PERBULAN") as "AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN PERBULAN",     max("JUMLAH HARI") as "JUMLAH HARI",     sum("AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN hari") as "AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN hari",     sum("RP") / nullif(sum("AVG JUMLAH PENJUALAN PERBULAN"), 0) as "HARGA POKOK",     sum("STOK MIN") as "STOK MIN",     sum("STOK MAX") as "STOK MAX",     sum("RP") as "RP"  from gba  group by "BARANG GABUNGAN" ), h as (  select sum("RP") as "TOTAL"  from gbm ), u as (  select      *,     (select "TOTAL" from h),     ROUND((("RP"::numeric / (select "TOTAL" from h)) * 100)::numeric, 3) as "PERSENTASE",     sum(ROUND((("RP"::numeric / (select "TOTAL" from h)) * 100)::numeric, 3)) over (order by (ROUND((("RP"::numeric / (select "TOTAL" from h)) * 100)::numeric, 3)) desc) as "KUMULATIF PENGGUNAAN" from gbm order by ROUND((("RP"::numeric / (select "TOTAL" from h)) * 100)::numeric, 3) desc ), pareto as ( select      u.*,     CASE          WHEN "KUMULATIF PENGGUNAAN" <= 70 THEN 'A'         WHEN "KUMULATIF PENGGUNAAN" <= 90 THEN 'B'         ELSE 'C'     END AS kategori_abc from u ), -- ============================================================ -- DATA HARIAN UNTUK FORECASTING -- ============================================================ base_harian as ( select      mvp."ID BARANG",     mvp."BARANG",     trim(regexp_replace(upper(mvp."BARANG"), '\s*${[}^{(})]*$\s*$', '')) as "BARANG GABUNGAN",     date_trunc('day', mvp."TGL JUAL"::timestamp)::date as tanggal,     SUM(mvp."QTY") as qty_total from emr_view.mv_validasi_penjualan mvp  LEFT JOIN public.transaksi_detail_barangs p ON p.id = mvp."ID TRANSAKSI" left join (     select id, is_active     from public.wf_ms_barangs wmb      where wmb."deletedAt" is null       and wmb.hargapokok is not null ) b on b.id = mvp."ID BARANG" where mvp.tarif_cbg = 'obat' and mvp."TGL JUAL"::timestamp >= '2026-03-01' and mvp."TGL JUAL"::timestamp <  '2026-10-01' AND mvp."ID KUNJUNGAN" IS NOT NULL and p."deletedAt" IS null and is_active is true and mvp."HARGA POKOK" is not null group by      mvp."ID BARANG",     mvp."BARANG",     trim(regexp_replace(upper(mvp."BARANG"), '\s*${[}^{(})]*$\s*$', '')),     date_trunc('day', mvp."TGL JUAL"::timestamp)::date ), -- Jumlahkan qty harian semua varian supplier harian_gab as (  select "BARANG GABUNGAN", tanggal, sum(qty_total) as qty_total  from base_harian  group by "BARANG GABUNGAN", tanggal ), -- Sisa stok dijumlah dari semua ID varian stok_gab as (  select m."BARANG GABUNGAN", sum(wi.qty) as "SISA STOK"  from (select distinct "ID BARANG", "BARANG GABUNGAN" from base_harian) m  join public.wf_inventories wi    on wi.barang_id = m."ID BARANG" and wi."deletedAt" is null  group by m."BARANG GABUNGAN" ) -- ============================================================ -- OUTPUT: harian × label Pareto (per obat gabungan) -- ============================================================ select      hg.tanggal,     p."ID BARANG",     hg."BARANG GABUNGAN" as "BARANG",     hg.qty_total,     p.kategori_abc,     p."PERSENTASE",     p."KUMULATIF PENGGUNAAN",     p."HARGA POKOK",     p."STOK MIN",     p."STOK MAX",     s."SISA STOK" from harian_gab hg left join pareto p on p."BARANG" = hg."BARANG GABUNGAN" left join stok_gab s on s."BARANG GABUNGAN" = hg."BARANG GABUNGAN" order by hg."BARANG GABUNGAN", hg.tanggal;

title: HAK KELAS BED
sql_query: WITH ek AS (     SELECT DISTINCT ON (ek."ID REGISTRASI")         ek."ID REGISTRASI"::text AS id_registrasi,         ek."KELAS RAWAT"     FROM emr_view.mv_dashboard_eklaim_2024 ek     ORDER BY ek."ID REGISTRASI" ), ri AS (     SELECT         ri.*,         b.nama_kelas AS "NAMA KELAS",         ek."KELAS RAWAT" AS kelas_tagih,         NULLIF(trim(ek."KELAS RAWAT"::text), '') AS kelas_tagih_norm,         -- normalisasi: "KELAS I" / "KELAS 1" -> '1'         CASE upper(trim(regexp_replace(ri."HAK KELAS BPJS", '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))             WHEN 'I' THEN '1' WHEN 'II' THEN '2' WHEN 'III' THEN '3'             ELSE upper(trim(regexp_replace(ri."HAK KELAS BPJS", '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))         END AS hak_kelas_norm,         CASE upper(trim(regexp_replace(b.nama_kelas, '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))             WHEN 'I' THEN '1' WHEN 'II' THEN '2' WHEN 'III' THEN '3'             ELSE upper(trim(regexp_replace(b.nama_kelas, '^\s*KELAS\s*', '', 'i')))         END AS kelas_bed_norm,         CASE             WHEN DATE_PART('day', ri."WAKTU PULANG"::timestamp - ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp) = 0 THEN 1             ELSE DATE_PART('day', ri."WAKTU PULANG"::timestamp - ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp) + 1         END AS "LOS"     FROM emr_view.mv_rawat_inap ri     left join (SELECT mb_1.id,                       mb_1.name AS nama_bed,                       mb_1.kelas_id,                       mb_1.kamar_id,                       mkk.nama_kelas                FROM ms_beds mb_1                LEFT JOIN (SELECT mk_1.id,                                  mk_1.name AS nama_kelas,                                  mk_1.remark                           FROM ms_kelaskamars mk_1                           WHERE mk_1."deletedAt" IS NULL) mkk ON mkk.id = mb_1.kelas_id) b on b.nama_bed = ri."NAMA BED"     LEFT JOIN ek ON ek.id_registrasi = ri."ID REGISTRASI RANAP"::text     WHERE ri."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp >= '2026-01-01'     and "NAMA ASURANSI" = 'BPJS'     --  AND ri.waktu_dihapus IS NULL ), sesuai AS (     SELECT         "ID REGISTRASI RANAP",         COALESCE(             bool_or(                 kelas_bed_norm = hak_kelas_norm                 AND date_start::timestamp <= "TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp + interval '72 hours'             ), false         ) AS pernah_sesuai,         COALESCE(             bool_or(                 kelas_bed_norm = kelas_tagih_norm                 AND date_start::timestamp <= "TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp + interval '72 hours'             ), false         ) AS pernah_sesuai_tagih,         string_agg(DISTINCT "NAMA KELAS", ', ') AS riwayat_kelas     FROM ri     GROUP BY "ID REGISTRASI RANAP" ), last_bed AS (     SELECT DISTINCT ON ("ID REGISTRASI RANAP") *     FROM ri     ORDER BY "ID REGISTRASI RANAP", date_start DESC NULLS LAST ) SELECT     lb."ID REGISTRASI RANAP",     lb."ID REGISTRASI ASAL",     lb."TGL REGISTRASI RANAP"::timestamp AS "TGL REGISTRASI RANAP",     lb."NO RM",     lb."NAMA PASIEN",     lb."TGL LAHIR",     lb."UMUR",     lb."JENIS KELAMIN",     lb."DPJP RAWAT INAP",     lb."SPESIALIS RAWAT INAP",     lb."NAMA ASURANSI",     lb."HAK KELAS BPJS",     lb."NAMA RUANG",     lb."NAMA KAMAR",     lb."NAMA BED"   AS "BED TERAKHIR",     lb."NAMA KELAS" AS "KELAS BED TERAKHIR",     s.riwayat_kelas AS "RIWAYAT KELAS BED",     CASE         WHEN lb."NAMA ASURANSI" <> 'BPJS' THEN 'Non BPJS'         WHEN s.pernah_sesuai THEN 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "STATUS BED SESUAI",     case         when lb."WAKTU PULANG" is null then 'Belum Pulang'         when lb.kelas_bed_norm = lb.hak_kelas_norm then 'Sesuai'         else 'Tidak Sesuai'     end as "STATUS BED SESUAI (PULANG)",     case         when lb."WAKTU PULANG" is null then 'Belum Pulang'         WHEN lb."NAMA ASURANSI" <> 'BPJS' THEN 'Non BPJS'         WHEN s.pernah_sesuai and lb.kelas_bed_norm = lb.hak_kelas_norm THEN 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "STATUS BED SESUAI KESELURUHAN",     -- ===== tambahan: berdasarkan kelas yang ditagihkan (e-klaim) =====     lb.kelas_tagih AS "KELAS DITAGIHKAN",     CASE         WHEN lb.kelas_tagih_norm IS NULL THEN 'Belum Ditagihkan'         WHEN s.pernah_sesuai_tagih THEN 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "STATUS BED SESUAI (KLAIM)",     CASE         WHEN lb."WAKTU PULANG" IS NULL THEN 'Belum Pulang'         WHEN lb.kelas_tagih_norm IS NULL THEN 'Belum Ditagihkan'         WHEN lb.kelas_bed_norm = lb.kelas_tagih_norm THEN 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "STATUS BED SESUAI (PULANG) (KLAIM)",     CASE         WHEN lb."WAKTU PULANG" IS NULL THEN 'Belum Pulang'         WHEN lb.kelas_tagih_norm IS NULL THEN 'Belum Ditagihkan'         WHEN s.pernah_sesuai_tagih AND lb.kelas_bed_norm = lb.kelas_tagih_norm THEN 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "STATUS BED SESUAI KESELURUHAN (KLAIM)",     -- =================================================================     lb."DIAGNOSA UTAMA",     lb."DIAGNOSA SEKUNDER",     lb."PROSEDUR UTAMA",     lb."PROSEDUR SEKUNDER",     lb."WAKTU PULANG"::timestamp AS "WAKTU PULANG",     lb."Cara keluar",     lb."LOS" FROM last_bed lb JOIN sesuai s ON s."ID REGISTRASI RANAP" = lb."ID REGISTRASI RANAP"

title: Jadwal Praktek Dokter -forecast obat
sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT     sd."WAKTU REVISI"::DATE AS tanggal,     REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(rj."DOKTER"), '(\m[[:alpha:]])[[:alpha:]]+(?![.[:alpha:]])', '\1***', 'g') AS dokter_sensor,     rj."SPESIALIS" FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan rj  LEFT JOIN (     SELECT         a.schedule_doctor_id,         a.registration_id,         (jda.tanggal_asli::TEXT || ' ' || sda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP   AS "WAKTU ASLI",         (jda.tanggal::TEXT || ' ' || jda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP        AS "WAKTU REVISI",         (jda.tanggal_asli::TEXT || ' ' || sda.time_finish)::TIMESTAMP  AS "WAKTU SELESAI ASLI",         (jda.tanggal::TEXT || ' ' || jda.time_finish)::TIMESTAMP       AS "WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"     FROM public.antrianlists a     LEFT JOIN public.jadwal_dokter_aktif jda ON jda.id_jadwal_dokter_aktif = a.id_jadwal_dokter_aktif     LEFT JOIN public.schedule_doctors sda ON sda.id = a.schedule_doctor_id ) sd ON sd.registration_id = rj."ID REGISTRASI" WHERE sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL    AND sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL   AND (         sd."WAKTU REVISI"::DATE BETWEEN '2026-09-17' AND '2026-09-29'      OR sd."WAKTU REVISI"::DATE BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-14'   )   AND UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(rj."SPESIALIS"), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) NOT IN (       'AKUPUNKTUR',       'ANESTESI',       'FISIOTERAPI',       'GIGI UMUM',       'GIZI KLINIK',       'KEDOKTERAN OKUPASI',       'LAKTASI',       'MCU',       'MEMORI',       'OKUPASI TERAPIS',       'PSIKOLOGI KLINIS',       'RADIOLOGI',       'TERAPI NYERI',       'TERAPI PERILAKU',       'TERAPI WICARA'   ) ORDER BY tanggal, rj."SPESIALIS", dokter_sensor;

title: Skor Pareto Spesialis 2025 - 2026  -forecast obat
sql_query: WITH pareto AS (     SELECT t.*,            SUM(t.jml_kunjungan) OVER (ORDER BY t.jml_kunjungan DESC, t."DOKTER")            * 100.0            / SUM(t.jml_kunjungan) OVER () AS persen_kumulatif     FROM (         SELECT rj."SPESIALIS",                rj."DOKTER",                COUNT(DISTINCT rj."ID REGISTRASI") AS jml_kunjungan         FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan rj         WHERE rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP >= '2025-01-01'           AND UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(rj."SPESIALIS"), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) NOT IN (               'AKUPUNKTUR',               'ANESTESI',               'FISIOTERAPI',               'GIGI UMUM',               'GIZI KLINIK',               'KEDOKTERAN OKUPASI',               'LAKTASI',               'MCU',               'MEMORI',               'OKUPASI TERAPIS',               'PSIKOLOGI KLINIS',               'RADIOLOGI',               'TERAPI NYERI',               'TERAPI PERILAKU',               'TERAPI WICARA'           )         GROUP BY rj."SPESIALIS", rj."DOKTER"     ) t ), kategori_dokter AS (     SELECT p."SPESIALIS",            p."DOKTER",            CASE WHEN p.persen_kumulatif <= 50 THEN 'A'                 WHEN p.persen_kumulatif <= 90 THEN 'B'                 ELSE 'C' END AS kategori_pareto,            CASE WHEN p.persen_kumulatif <= 50 THEN 3                 WHEN p.persen_kumulatif <= 90 THEN 2                 ELSE 1 END AS skor     FROM pareto p ), harian AS (     SELECT rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::DATE AS tanggal,            rj."SPESIALIS",            rj."DOKTER"     FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan rj     WHERE rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP >= '2025-01-01'       AND UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(rj."SPESIALIS"), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) NOT IN (           'AKUPUNKTUR',           'ANESTESI',           'FISIOTERAPI',           'GIGI UMUM',           'GIZI KLINIK',           'KEDOKTERAN OKUPASI',           'LAKTASI',           'MCU',           'MEMORI',           'OKUPASI TERAPIS',           'PSIKOLOGI KLINIS',           'RADIOLOGI',           'TERAPI NYERI',           'TERAPI PERILAKU',           'TERAPI WICARA'       )     GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), skor_harian AS (     SELECT h.tanggal,            UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(h."SPESIALIS"), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS spesialis_rapi,            k.skor     FROM harian h     JOIN kategori_dokter k       ON k."SPESIALIS" = h."SPESIALIS"      AND k."DOKTER" = h."DOKTER" ) SELECT s.tanggal,        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'BEDAH ANAK'), 0)                      AS "BEDAH ANAK",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'LABORATORIUM'), 0)                    AS "LABORATORIUM",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'PENYAKIT DALAM'), 0)                  AS "PENYAKIT DALAM",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'JANTUNG'), 0)                         AS "JANTUNG",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'KONSERVASI GIGI'), 0)                 AS "KONSERVASI GIGI",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'UMUM'), 0)                            AS "UMUM",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'BEDAH MULUT'), 0)                     AS "BEDAH MULUT",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'PROSTHODONTI'), 0)                    AS "PROSTHODONTI",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'REHABILITASI MEDIK'), 0)              AS "REHABILITASI MEDIK",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'BEDAH VASCULAR & ENDOVASCULAR'), 0)   AS "BEDAH VASCULAR & ENDOVASCULAR",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'ANAK'), 0)                            AS "ANAK",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'BEDAH UMUM'), 0)                      AS "BEDAH UMUM",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'PARU'), 0)                            AS "PARU",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'THT - KL'), 0)                        AS "THT - KL",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'PERIODONTI'), 0)                      AS "PERIODONTI",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'KANDUNGAN'), 0)                       AS "KANDUNGAN",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'GIGI RADIOLOGI'), 0)                  AS "GIGI RADIOLOGI",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'KEDOKTERAN JIWA'), 0)                 AS "KEDOKTERAN JIWA",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'HEMODIALISA'), 0)                     AS "HEMODIALISA",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'ORTHOPEDI'), 0)                       AS "ORTHOPEDI",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'KULIT & KELAMIN'), 0)                 AS "KULIT & KELAMIN",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'UROLOGI'), 0)                         AS "UROLOGI",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'ANAK NEUROLOGI'), 0)                  AS "ANAK NEUROLOGI",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'BEDAH SYARAF'), 0)                    AS "BEDAH SYARAF",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'SARAF'), 0)                           AS "SARAF",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'MATA'), 0)                            AS "MATA",        COALESCE(SUM(s.skor) FILTER (WHERE s.spesialis_rapi = 'KEDOKTERAN GIGI ANAK'), 0)            AS "KEDOKTERAN GIGI ANAK",        SUM(s.skor)                                                                                   AS total_skor FROM skor_harian s GROUP BY s.tanggal ORDER BY s.tanggal; -- SELECT DISTINCT "SPESIALIS" FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan

title: Kategori Pareto Dokter  -forecast obat
sql_query: WITH pareto AS (     SELECT t.*,            SUM(t.jml_kunjungan) OVER (ORDER BY t.jml_kunjungan DESC, t."DOKTER")            * 100.0            / SUM(t.jml_kunjungan) OVER () AS persen_kumulatif     FROM (         SELECT rj."SPESIALIS",                rj."DOKTER",                COUNT(DISTINCT rj."ID REGISTRASI") AS jml_kunjungan         FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan rj         WHERE rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP >= '2025-01-01'         GROUP BY rj."SPESIALIS", rj."DOKTER"     ) t ) SELECT p."SPESIALIS",       REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(p."DOKTER"), '(\m[[:alpha:]])[[:alpha:]]+(?![.[:alpha:]])', '\1***', 'g') AS dokter_sensor,       -- p."DOKTER",        p.jml_kunjungan,       REPLACE(ROUND(p.persen_kumulatif, 2)::TEXT, '.', ',') AS persen_kumulatif,              CASE WHEN p.persen_kumulatif <= 50 THEN 'A'             WHEN p.persen_kumulatif <= 90 THEN 'B'             ELSE 'C' END AS kategori_pareto FROM pareto p WHERE p."SPESIALIS" NOT IN (       'AKUPUNKTUR',       'ANESTESI',       'FISIOTERAPI',       'GIGI Umum',       'GIZI KLINIK',       'KEDOKTERAN OKUPASI',       'LAKTASI',       'MCU',       'MEMORI',       'OKUPASI TERAPIS',       'PSIKOLOGI KLINIS',       'RADIOLOGI',       'TERAPI NYERI',       'TERAPI PERILAKU',       'TERAPI WICARA'     ) ORDER BY p.jml_kunjungan DESC, p."DOKTER";

title: Kepatuhan RJ + Mingguan
sql_query: SELECT      sub.*,          -- KATEGORI 2: Level Sesi Praktik (ID PRAKTEK)     -- Jika ada >= 1 pasien tidak sesuai di sesi tersebut, seluruh sesi jadi 'Tidak Sesuai'     CASE          WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sub.kategori_pasien = 'Tidak Sesuai' THEN 1 END) OVER (             PARTITION BY sub."ID PRAKTEK"         ) > 0 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'         ELSE 'Sesuai'     END AS "KATEGORI_SESI",     -- KATEGORI 3: Level Bulanan Dokter     -- Jika ada >= 1 catatan tidak sesuai dalam 1 bulan, seluruh baris dokter di bulan itu jadi 'Tidak Sesuai'     CASE          WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sub."KATEGORI" = 'Tidak Sesuai' THEN 1 END) OVER (             PARTITION BY sub."DOKTER", DATE_TRUNC('month', sub."TGL REGIS")         ) > 0 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'         ELSE 'Sesuai'     END AS "KATEGORI_BULANAN",          -- KATEGORI 4 = Tidak ada Toleransi Beda Jadwal     CASE          WHEN sub."WAKTU ASLI" = sub."WAKTU REVISI"              AND sub."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI" = sub."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"         THEN 'Sesuai'         ELSE 'Tidak Sesuai'     END AS "KATEGORI_4",            -- KATEGORI 5: Level Sesi Praktik (ID PRAKTEK)     -- Jika ada >= 1 pasien tidak sesuai di sesi tersebut, seluruh sesi jadi 'Tidak Sesuai'     CASE          WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sub.kategori_pasien5 = 'Tidak Sesuai' THEN 1 END) OVER (             PARTITION BY sub."ID PRAKTEK"         ) > 0 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'         ELSE 'Sesuai'     END AS "KATEGORI_5",          -- KATEGORI 6: Level Bulanan Dokter2     -- Jika ada >= 1 catatan tidak sesuai dalam 1 bulan (Kategori 4), seluruh baris dokter di bulan itu jadi 'Tidak Sesuai' -- KATEGORI 6: Level Bulanan Dokter berdasarkan KATEGORI 4     CASE          WHEN COUNT(             CASE                  WHEN sub."WAKTU ASLI" <> sub."WAKTU REVISI"                   OR sub."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI" <> sub."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"                 THEN 1             END         ) OVER (             PARTITION BY sub."DOKTER", DATE_TRUNC('month', sub."TGL REGIS")         ) > 0          THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'         ELSE 'Sesuai'     END AS "KATEGORI_6",          -- KATEGORI 7 : toleransi 30 menit sebelum task id 4     sub.kategori_task4 AS "KATEGORI REAL", rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP AS "TGL REGIS",         ((rj."TANGGAL REGISTRASI"::TIMESTAMP)::DATE)::TEXT || sd.schedule_doctor_id AS "ID PRAKTEK",         sd.schedule_doctor_id,         sd."WAKTU      -- Level sesi: pasien pertama task_id_4 maks 30 menit sebelum jadwal asli         -- CASE         --     WHEN MIN(t4."TASK 4") OVER (         --             PARTITION BY ((rj."TANGGAL ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 <= 60 THEN 'Sesuai'             WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60                  AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'             WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 <= 60                  AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'             WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 > 60                  AND ABS(DATE_PART('epoch', sd."WAKTU SELESAI REVISI"::TIMESTAMP - sd."WAKTU SELESAI ASLI"::TIMESTAMP)) / 60 <= 60 THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'             WHEN sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NULL THEN 'Sesuai'             WHEN sd."WAKTU ASLI" IS NOT NULL AND sd."WAKTU REVISI" IS NULL THEN 'Tidak Sesuai'         END AS "KATEGORI"     FROM emr_view.mv_validasi_kunjungan_rawat_jalan rj      LEFT JOIN (         SELECT             a.schedule_doctor_id,             a.registration_id,             (jda.tanggal_asli::TEXT || ' ' || sda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP   AS "WAKTU ASLI",             (jda.tanggal::TEXT || ' ' || jda.time_start)::TIMESTAMP        AS "WAKTU sda ON sda.id = a.schedule_doctor_id     ) sd ON sd.registration_id = rj."ID REGISTRASI"     LEFT JOIN (         select              ak.id_kunjungan,             ak.inserted_date + interval '7 hours' as "TANGGAL INPUT ASKEP"         from emr_rawat_jalan.asesmen_keperawatan ak          where ak.deleted_date is null         ) ak on ak.id_kunjungan = rj."ID REGISTRASI"     LEFT JOIN (         SELECT             jkn.id_registrations,             MAX(CASE WHEN jkn.task_id = 1 THEN jkn.tanggal AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta' END) AS "TASK 1",             MAX(CASE WHEN jkn.task_id = 2 THEN jkn.tanggal AT s.awal_minggu = sp.awal_minggu AND s."DOKTER" = sp."DOKTER"  -- untuk ambil SPESIALIS GROUP BY sp.awal_minggu, sp."DOKTER" ORDER BY sp.awal_minggu, sp."DOKTER";

title: Boxplot Peak Hour IGD
sql_query: WITH data AS (   SELECT     igd."Id Registrasi",     atg.waktu_asesmen_triage                      AS waktu_triage,     -- NULLIF(TRIM(igd."Tanggal Pulang"), '')::timestamp AS waktu_keluar     NULLIF(TRIM(igd."Tanggal Pulang"), '')::timestamp AS waktu_pulang_asli,     CASE       WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(igd."Tanggal Pulang"), '')::timestamp              BETWEEN atg.waktu_asesmen_triage                  AND atg.waktu_asesmen_triage + interval '24 hours'       THEN NULLIF(TRIM(igd."Tanggal Pulang"), '')::timestamp       ELSE atg.waktu_asesmen_triage + interval '24 hours'     END AS waktu_keluar   FROM emr_view.mv_dashboard_igd igd   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT id_triage,            MIN(inserted_date::timestamp + interval '7 hour') AS waktu_asesmen_triage     FROM emr_igd.asesmen_triage     GROUP BY id_triage   ) atg ON atg.id_triage = igd."Id Triage" ), batas AS (   SELECT     date_trunc('day', MIN(waktu_triage)) AS mulai,     date_trunc('day', MAX(waktu_triage)) + interval '23 hours' AS selesai   FROM data   WHERE waktu_triage IS NOT NULL ), slot AS (   SELECT generate_series(mulai, selesai, interval '1 hour') AS jam   FROM batas ), masuk AS (   SELECT date_trunc('hour', waktu_triage) AS jam,          COUNT(DISTINCT "Id Registrasi") AS jml   FROM data   WHERE waktu_triage IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1 ), keluar AS (   SELECT date_trunc('hour', waktu_keluar) AS jam,          COUNT(DISTINCT "Id Registrasi") AS jml   FROM data   WHERE waktu_triage IS NOT NULL     AND waktu_keluar >= waktu_triage   GROUP BY 1 ), sedang AS (   SELECT s.jam,          COUNT(DISTINCT d."Id Registrasi") AS jml   FROM slot s   -- JOIN data d   --   ON d.waktu_triage < s.jam + interval '1 hour'   -- AND COALESCE(   --       CASE WHEN d.waktu_keluar >= d.waktu_triage THEN d.waktu_keluar END,   --       d.waktu_triage + interval '24 hours'   --     ) > s.jam   JOIN data d   ON d.waktu_triage < s.jam + interval '1 hour'   AND d.waktu_keluar >= s.jam + interval '1 hour'      WHERE s.jam >= '2026-01-01'   GROUP BY s.jam ) SELECT   s.jam::date                   AS tanggal,   EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.jam)::int AS jam,   COALESCE(m.jml, 0)            AS pasien_masuk,   COALESCE(k.jml, 0)            AS pasien_keluar,   COALESCE(sd.jml, 0)           AS pasien_di_igd FROM slot s LEFT JOIN masuk  m  ON m.jam  = s.jam LEFT JOIN keluar k  ON k.jam  = s.jam LEFT JOIN sedang sd ON sd.jam = s.jam WHERE s.jam >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY s.jam;

title: LOS
sql_query:
CASE   
        WHEN to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  IS NULL   
        OR to_timestamp("WAKTU IRNA AKHIR", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  IS NULL THEN NULL   
        WHEN DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) = DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) THEN '1'::NUMERIC  
        WHEN FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , now()) - to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )/86400) = 0 THEN '1'::NUMERIC  
        ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE_TRUNC('day', to_timestamp("WAKTU PULANG", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')  + INTERVAL '1 DAY') - to_timestamp("TGL REGISTRASI RANAP", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )::NUMERIC  
    END AS "LOS",
